peak_days: Saturdays (dedicated to Lord Narasimha), Tuesdays (dedicated to Lord Hanuman), Sundays
peak_seasons: Annual 13-day Brahmotsavam Jathara (February – March), Mukti Pradayini Karthika Masam (November), Godavari Pushkaralu (every 12 years), Hanuman Jayanti, Narasimha Jayanti, Vaikuntha Ekadashi, Maha Shivaratri
average_wait_time: 10 to 20 minutes on weekdays (Mon–Thu); 45 minutes to 1.5 hours on weekends (Sat–Sun); 1 to 2.5 hours on auspicious Saturdays and Tuesdays
peak_wait_time: Overflowing / maximum crunch during Brahmotsavam Jathara (especially Kalyanotsavam and Rathotsavam days)
recommended_visiting_hours: Weekdays (Mon–Thu) early morning or evening for very low crowd density and peaceful experience
crowd_management_notes: Synchronized operation by Jagtial district administration, municipal board, and police. Includes strict vehicular cordon banning vehicles past main Temple Arch Kaman, peripheral dirt parking along incoming highways, one-way pedestrian circuits, barricaded holding sheds (pandalas) with industrial fans and shade canopies, multi-lane segregation (Sarva Darshan vs paid pooja lines), security nets/floating ropes/lifeguards/overhead showers at bathing ghats, Central Command Control Room, CCTV analytics at Koneru pond and alleyways, and Public Address loudspeaker network.
